bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
image=create-videobot:poll-fresh
docker image inspect "$image" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 61
if docker run --rm --network none --pull never --user 0:0 --entrypoint /bin/sh "$image" -c 'test -f /opt/videobot/src/runtime/main.mjs' >/dev/null 2>&1;then
 if docker run --rm --network none --pull never --user node --entrypoint /bin/sh "$image" -c 'test -f /opt/videobot/src/runtime/main.mjs' >/dev/null 2>&1;then
  exit 0
 else
  exit 80
 fi
fi
exit 81
